stratagems.name: Power from Pain
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after a DRUKHARI unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Each model in your unit regains 1 lost wound. In addition, your unit gains 1 Power from Pain token.

stratagems.name: Webway Portal
stratagems.when: Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One DRUKHARI unit from your army that is in Reserves.
stratagems.effect: Set up that unit anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" horizontally from all enemy models.

stratagems.name: Torment Grenade
stratagems.target: One DRUKHARI unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack, on an unmodified Wound roll of 6, that attack has the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

stratagems.name: Labyrinthine Cunning
stratagems.target: One DRUKHARI KABAL unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, each time an enemy unit targets your unit, that enemy unit must subtract 1 from all Hit rolls.
